additional_info.subject: ID0468738-DC/Si-D/PT- [Y2 / R3 312881977040] Network Issue CRM:03289000042
additional_info.body:
Hi Roberto, buenos dias. How are you?
I checked the router remotely and all the settings are correctly done.
The fastest thing we can do is simply get a laptop and connect to the Ethernet cable coming to the Router:
If internet works in your laptop
Is the cable connected to the FA?
If yes, try to connect it directly on the WAN port of the Router
If it's not working
Factory reset the router and try again
If it's still not working - replace the router
If no (connected directly to WAN)
Factory reset the router
If persists, replace the router
If internet does not work in your laptop
Ethernet cable problem or network issue.
Since we are not able to do any more tasks remotely, I will forward this ticket to RC-ES queue.
If you need any support please reach out to me with at least 1 day in advance.
Thank you and have a lovely holiday season.
Best regards,
Francisco
